prompt: Add `Checkout.pay(cart, code, country, cardToken)` in src/shop/Checkout.java. It applies the coupon `code` from the coupon book, which must refuse an expired coupon with `CouponExpiredException`; adds VAT for the customer's country (20% for "GB", 19% for "DE", 21% for "NL", none elsewhere; more countries will follow); charges the result in euros through `StripeClient.createCharge` in src/shop/StripeClient.java; and returns the charge id. We may add PayPal at some point. `App.buildCheckout(client)` in src/shop/App.java must return a ready checkout that charges through `client`.
